_comment: Figures that NO public API exposes (publisher-announced units / MAU / registered accounts). Every row is a seed: `run.py verify` prints them and each one must be re-checked at source_url before the number is published. value=null means 'no trustworthy figure seeded yet - go get it'. Nothing in this file is inferred by the pipeline; the estimator only consumes rows with verified=true unless --allow-unverified is passed.

figures.note: Stale by design - shows how the freshness penalty works. Replace with the newest Microsoft/Mojang disclosure.
Take-Two restates shipped units every quarter - always pull the newest 10-Q.

figures.source_name: Nintendo IR - Top Selling Title Sales Units
figures.note: Nintendo publishes per-title units quarterly; decide whether the row is BotW only, TotK only, or the franchise sum, and say so in the report.
Elden Ring units are announced by press release; Dark Souls series units come from Bandai Namco IR decks.
Registered accounts are NOT players. The estimator converts them with registered_to_mau (see config/model.json) and the report must label the row as account-derived.
Riot stopped publishing MAU. Any number here is a third-party estimate and must be labelled as such.

figures.source_name: Sensor Tower / AppMagic (paid) - HoYoverse does not disclose
